blocking_findings.finding: PR6-PERF-04 is not yet implementation-ready because every named zoom→zoom replacement is another Radix Select selection. After the initiating selection, Radix closes and unmounts its portalled listbox. At the frame where the in-flight render is observed, selecting 400% requires reopening the trigger, waiting for React/Radix to mount the portal, and then activating the option. It therefore cannot be synchronously dispatched in that same observation frame as specified. Yielding across that reopening permits the superseded render to settle and recreates the race the repair is intended to eliminate. The same issue affects the max-zoom pair. A direct 100%/200% selection remains feasible for P-4a because opening the listbox can occur before t0 and only the option activation must be timed; this does not rescue P-4b's synchronous replacement requirement.
blocking_findings.required_change: Replace each P-4b replacement with a distinct, enabled, non-no-op control that is already mounted and can be synchronously activated at the in-flight observation point, while retaining real React state/gen/render behavior. For example, initiate through the combobox, then replace through an enabled stepped zoom or fit button; specify exact entry states and resulting targets for every rung, including max zoom and current-fit cases. Alternatively, specify and justify an executable Radix event sequence that completes the second selection without awaiting portal remount. Keep the baseline, initiating gesture, in-flight proof, synchronous replacement, second-generation proof, escalation, ordering, stale-paint, and loud-failure requirements inside one page evaluation.

non_blocking_observations.observation: The boolean exemption is withdrawn. The `(docId, genId, epochSeq)` batch has a deterministic lifecycle, admits the initial/current-generation active window, closes on the next visible-set mutation, carries identity through awaits, and has explicit T2–T4 coverage. The required close-before-new-entry ordering follows from closing at the mutation boundary, though implementation tests should make that ordering explicit.

Pending identity, invalidation, stale callback behavior, atomic claim, sequential exact revalidation, canvas Map identity, ungated start path, and required race tests are specified coherently against the current hook structure.

The terminal-step equivalence is withdrawn. The fixed-stop zoom combobox is an approved product control rather than test scaffolding, uses the real state/gen/render path, preserves stepped controls, defines no-op behavior, and restores literal 20-sample 100%↔200% P-4a measurement in one page clock. Starting at fit-width is coherent: selecting 100% is a real commit because it changes fit mode to custom even if the stored numeric zoom is already 1. Task .6's R4/R5 amendment is coherent without reopening task .4.
